name: Tara R. Devine
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Waukegan, Illinois
side_practice_areas: Personal Injury, Medical Malpractice, Health Care
about: Tara R. Devine is a Partner at Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard and the Managing Partner of the firm’s Lake County office in Waukegan, Illinois. A highly respected trial attorney, she concentrates her practice on personal injury, nursing home negligence, wrongful death, medical malpractice, and product liability litigation. Known for her thoughtful advocacy, meticulous preparation, and unwavering commitment, she has recovered more than $325 million in verdicts and settlements on behalf of her clients.

During law school, Ms. Devine worked as a law clerk under Founder Patrick Salvi Sr. Upon graduating and passing the bar in 2004, she joined the firm as an attorney. She made history as the firm’s first female Partner in 2011 and was appointed Managing Partner of the Lake County office in 2018. In this role, she leads with a commitment to exceptional client service, oversees complex litigation, and serves as a mentor to Lake County attorneys, staff, and law clerks.

Over the course of her career, Ms. Devine has built an impressive record of success, securing numerous multimillion-dollar verdicts and settlements. Most notably, she was part of the trial team that obtained a record-setting $148 million jury verdict in 2017 on behalf of a young dancer who was paralyzed when a pedestrian shelter collapsed onto her at O’Hare International Airport. The verdict remains the highest compensatory award ever granted to an individual plaintiff in Illinois history.

While her results have earned recognition throughout the state and legal community, she understands that behind every case is a family facing uncertainty. She approaches every matter with determination, compassion, and strategic focus, working to ensure her clients feel informed, supported, and confident throughout every stage of the legal process. Her ability to meld compassionate client service with tenacious courtroom advocacy allows her to effectively guide clients through some of the most difficult moments of their lives.

Beyond her work on behalf of clients, Ms. Devine is a recognized leader who is deeply committed to advancing the legal profession. She is a Past President of the Lake County Bar Association (2022-2023) and serves on the Board of Managers of the Illinois Trial Lawyers Association (ITLA). In 2023, she was appointed by the Illinois Supreme Court to serve on the Committee on Jury Instructions in Civil Cases, helping shape jury instructions used in courtrooms throughout the state. She is also a frequent speaker at legal seminars and remains an active member of the American Association for Justice, the Chicago Bar Association, the Illinois State Bar Association, and the State Bar of Wisconsin.

Ms. Devine’s accomplishments have earned her consistent recognition among the legal profession’s most respected organizations. She has been selected to The Best Lawyers in America® since 2021 for Medical Malpractice Law, Personal Injury Litigation, and Product Liability Litigation. She has repeatedly been named to the Illinois Super Lawyers and Super Lawyers “Top 100” list, recognized as one of Crain’s Chicago Business ’ “Notable Women in Law” since 2020, and named a Leading Lawyer by Law Bulletin Media since 2016.

Ms. Devine earned her Bachelor of Arts from the University of Illinois before receiving her Juris Doctor from Marquette University. She is admitted to practice before the Illinois and Wisconsin state courts, as well as the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois and the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Wisconsin. For Ms. Devine, every case is about more than obtaining a favorable result—it is about helping clients find answers, accountability, and the resources needed to move forward after a life-changing event.
